ui.ending.title: The End of 48 Weeks
ui.ending.subtitle: Lumen remembers the direction Noa chose.
ui.event.legacy: A legacy record has opened a new choice.
milestone.spring.title: Spring Star Seed
milestone.summer.title: Summer Bridge
milestone.autumn.title: Autumn Letter
milestone.winter.title: Winter Door
milestone.frost.title: Seed Beneath the Frost
milestone.return.title: The Returning Waterway
milestone.constellation.title: Different Constellations
milestone.horizon.title: The Unnamed Horizon
location.archive.name: Star Archive
location.greenhouse.name: Lumen Greenhouse
location.market.name: Moonlit Market
location.riverRoad.name: Wind Road Beyond the River
legacy.stargazer.title: Legacy of the Stargazer
legacy.gardener.title: Legacy of the Gardener
legacy.pathfinder.title: Legacy of the Pathfinder
personality.quiet.name: Quiet Observer
personality.kind.name: Kind Connector
personality.bold.name: Brave Pathfinder
personality.bold.voice: They move first, even after a mistake.
personality.quiet.line: Stars do not hurry. Today, I will look slowly too.
personality.kind.line: When you smile, even the garden seems a little brighter.
personality.bold.line: If there is no road, we can make one with today's step!
event.mail.title: The Dawn Mailbox
event.mail.body: Before sunrise, a letter from nowhere arrived. Who should read it first?
event.mail.lumi.label: Ask Lumi for the star's name
event.mail.lumi.line: Naming the unknown brings it a little closer.
event.mail.bora.label: Share the news on the village board
event.mail.bora.line: Good news lasts longer when it is shared.
event.rain.title: The Night of Rain
event.rain.body: The village lamps went dark. Whose hand will Noa reach for first?
event.rain.bora.label: Share lantern light with the children
event.rain.bora.line: Even a small light becomes a path when shared.
event.rain.lumi.label: Read the stars and find the way
event.rain.lumi.line: The sky has not hidden its direction yet.
event.bridge.title: How to Cross the River
event.bridge.body: The old bridge trembles. With what heart will we cross today?
event.bridge.taro.label: Take the first step
event.bridge.taro.line: Even if I tremble, this step is mine.
event.bridge.bora.label: Match everyone's pace
event.bridge.bora.line: A river feels less frightening at one shared pace.
event.windmill.title: The Afternoon the Wind Stopped
event.windmill.body: The windmill stopped and the greenhouse window would not close. Who will help?
event.windmill.taro.label: Repair the windmill with Taro
event.windmill.taro.line: Even still wind can move again when hands reach it.
event.windmill.bora.label: Listen to Bora and Taro together
event.windmill.bora.line: When we hear each other's wind, we can build the road again.
event.letter.title: A Letter on the Wind
event.letter.body: A distant province asks for help. What answer will Noa send?
event.letter.lumi.label: Record a careful reply
event.letter.lumi.line: Precise words can become a road across distance.
event.letter.taro.label: Promise to go there in person
event.letter.taro.line: I will not make you wait. I will go.
event.festival.title: The Eve of the Festival
event.festival.body: One last preparation remains. What will Noa care for first?
event.festival.bora.label: Make a place for everyone to rest
event.festival.bora.line: A joyful day still needs a place to rest.
event.festival.taro.label: Build a new stage by hand
event.festival.taro.line: It may lean a little, but we will build it ourselves.
event.greenhouse.title: A Small Crack in the Greenhouse
event.greenhouse.body: A small crack appeared in the greenhouse roof. Whose way will protect spring?
event.greenhouse.lumi.label: Ask Lumi about the starlight angle
event.greenhouse.lumi.line: If we know where light rests, even a crack can become a path.
event.greenhouse.bora.label: Patch it with Bora
event.greenhouse.bora.line: A place we mend together will hold for a long time.
event.outing.market.title: A Walk Through the Moonlit Market
event.outing.market.body: A short holiday opens up. Who will Noa meet beyond Lumen after spending a few coins?
event.outing.market.lumi.label: Find an old map with Lumi
event.outing.market.lumi.line: Even a map's edge holds a clue to the next road.
event.outing.market.bora.label: Browse the seed stalls with Bora
event.outing.market.bora.line: If we choose the same seeds, tomorrow's garden may grow alike.
event.outing.hill.title: A Promise on the Wind Hill
event.outing.hill.body: The last holiday before the ending arrives. Whose walking time will shape the next season?
event.outing.hill.taro.label: Walk the unnamed road with Taro
event.outing.hill.taro.line: It is not too late to name a road after we walk it.
event.outing.hill.lumi.label: Leave a starlight marker with Lumi
event.outing.hill.lumi.line: A marker home means we can go far without losing the way.
event.bell.title: A Bell Beyond the Map
event.bell.body: Every evening, a bell rings beyond the map. Where will Noa listen?
event.bell.lumi.label: Record the bell's intervals with Lumi
event.bell.lumi.line: Record the intervals, and an unseen road may appear.
event.bell.taro.label: Find the bell with Taro
event.bell.taro.line: Let's walk all the way to where we hear it!
event.firstLedger.title: The First Ledger Night
event.firstLedger.body: The first twelve weeks are bound into one ledger. Will Noa keep only the numbers, or the voices that made them?
event.firstLedger.lumi.label: Record the order of evidence with Lumi
event.firstLedger.lumi.line: Do not record only the result; record the footsteps that reached it.
event.firstLedger.bora.label: Leave everyone's voice in the ledger with Bora
event.firstLedger.bora.line: When names enter the record, no one has to carry the decision alone.
event.frostWindow.title: The Greenhouse Beneath Frost
event.frostWindow.body: Overnight frost turns the greenhouse glass white. The seeds inside teach that waiting can come before light.
event.frostWindow.bora.label: Protect the seeds by lowering the heat with Bora
event.frostWindow.bora.line: Care sometimes needs the courage not to force growth.
event.frostWindow.taro.label: Repair the ice frame with Taro
event.frostWindow.taro.line: A stopped mechanism can move again when we inspect it piece by piece.
event.winterMarket.title: The Empty Chair at the Winter Market
event.winterMarket.body: An empty chair stands in the middle of the market. No one knows whether it waits for someone who left or someone who will arrive.
event.winterMarket.taro.label: Look for the chair's owner with Taro
event.winterMarket.taro.line: Do not fear an empty place; ask who it belongs to.
event.winterMarket.lumi.label: Record the time of waiting with Lumi
event.winterMarket.lumi.line: Waiting is also a map that lets someone return.
event.seedVault.title: The Seed Vault Door
event.seedVault.body: No seal marks the door to the storehouse across the river. Before opening it, Noa must find a reason everyone can share.
event.seedVault.lumi.label: Write public conditions with Lumi
event.seedVault.lumi.line: Before a key, let us make conditions anyone can check.
event.seedVault.bora.label: Share the vault's seeds with Bora
event.seedVault.bora.line: When the rule for sharing is shared, the seeds belong to no single person.
event.returningWater.title: The Back of the Returned Letter
event.returningWater.body: A reply arrives from the distant province. Behind its thanks is news that Lumen's choice reached more people than expected.
event.returningWater.bora.label: List the help we received with Bora
event.returningWater.bora.line: Remembering who helped us makes the next help fairer.
event.returningWater.taro.label: Walk the letter's road with Taro
event.returningWater.taro.line: If a letter arrived, we can walk that road again.
event.sharedRepair.title: A Door Lifted by Two Hands
event.sharedRepair.body: The new greenhouse door is too heavy for one person. Can people who repaired it differently hold the same handle?
event.sharedRepair.taro.label: Align the hinges again with Taro
event.sharedRepair.taro.line: Remove the wrong screw and align it again.
event.sharedRepair.lumi.label: Record the difference between designs with Lumi
event.sharedRepair.lumi.line: A different design can be evidence for the next choice, not an error.
event.riverCouncil.title: The Shared Well Promise
event.riverCouncil.body: The market argues over who should receive the shared well's water first. The rule-maker and the person drawing water both need a voice.
event.riverCouncil.lumi.label: Publish the distribution order with Lumi
event.riverCouncil.lumi.line: When everyone can see the order, waiting becomes a promise.
event.riverCouncil.bora.label: Check the most thirsty homes with Bora
event.riverCouncil.bora.line: A shared rule must still see who is thirsty now.
event.openRecord.title: The Open Record Day
event.openRecord.body: The first ledger is shown to everyone. Each reader finds a different blank, and Noa must choose whether to hide it or leave it as a question.
event.openRecord.bora.label: Hold a meeting to fill the blanks with Bora
event.openRecord.bora.line: A record stays alive when people can say what they do not know together.
event.openRecord.taro.label: Publish a map that marks every blank with Taro
event.openRecord.taro.line: When everyone sees the blank, no one has to find the next road alone.
event.threeMaps.title: Three Maps
event.threeMaps.body: Lumi's star map, Bora's seed map, and Taro's wind map lie on one table. The lines that disagree must be read together instead of erased.
event.threeMaps.taro.label: Check the road markers with Taro
event.threeMaps.taro.line: A map becomes a road when it meets the stones underfoot.
event.threeMaps.lumi.label: Find common lines with Lumi
event.threeMaps.lumi.line: Where different lines meet, there is a reason to verify together.
event.disagreement.title: The Night of Different Constellations
event.disagreement.body: Three judgments split inside the ledger once believed complete. Instead of choosing whose answer is right, Noa studies where each answer began.
event.disagreement.lumi.label: Place the evidence side by side with Lumi
event.disagreement.lumi.line: Before an answer, let us check whether we are looking at the same star.
event.disagreement.bora.label: Test the smallest agreement with Bora
event.disagreement.bora.line: A large promise grows when small agreements continue safely.
event.horizonMarket.title: The Horizon Market
event.horizonMarket.body: A market opens at Lumen's edge to launch a new route. Those who leave and those who stay must be able to read the same price tag.
event.horizonMarket.bora.label: Make a safe place for those who stay with Bora
event.horizonMarket.bora.line: Leaving is possible only when the place left behind is safe.
event.horizonMarket.taro.label: Raise the first marker of the new route with Taro
event.horizonMarket.taro.line: A first marker is a promise that the road can be found again, not a destination.
event.lastMarker.title: The Last Marker
event.lastMarker.body: On the last night before the ending, only one marker can remain on the wind road. Noa chooses a rule the next person can check over a name of their own.
event.lastMarker.taro.label: Raise a marker anyone can see with Taro
event.lastMarker.taro.line: The road must be findable even when I am gone.
event.lastMarker.lumi.label: Leave the last evidence as a constellation with Lumi
event.lastMarker.lumi.line: A final record is not closure; it is the start of the next verification.
companion.lumi.greeting: A record helps the heart find its way again.
companion.lumi.epilogue: Lumi left a tiny star beside the first page of Noa's record.
companion.bora.greeting: Time we grow together does not wither easily.
companion.bora.epilogue: Bora and Noa planted new seeds at the turning of every season.
companion.taro.greeting: Even a broken road can join again when we reach for it!
companion.taro.epilogue: Taro took Noa down a road that still had no name on any map.
ending.stargazer.title: Lumen's Stargazer
ending.stargazer.body: Noa read the grain of the night sky and lit the province's routes.
ending.stargazer-master.title: Navigator Who Counts the Dawn
ending.stargazer-master.body: Noa recorded the cycles of stars and wind for 48 weeks, leaving a map whose judgments everyone could verify.
ending.gardener.title: Gardener of Hearts
ending.gardener.body: Noa made a garden where different hearts could bloom together.
ending.gardener-master.title: Keeper of the Village Warmth
ending.gardener-master.body: Noa opened a square where stories could meet before quarrels began and every judgment's evidence could be read together.
ending.pathfinder.title: Pathfinder of New Roads
ending.pathfinder.body: Noa left the first footprint on a road without a name.
ending.pathfinder-master.title: Vanguard Beyond the Border
ending.pathfinder-master.body: Noa showed that one can move forward without erasing fear, leaving markers that let the next person replay the road.
chapter.arrival.title: The Starseed Arrives
chapter.arrival.premise: A strange record and a first letter disturb Lumen's quiet.
chapter.arrival.payoff: Noa decides whose voice to trust first.
chapter.crossing.title: The Trembling Bridge
chapter.crossing.premise: A growing heart learns that crossing together matters more than being first.
chapter.crossing.payoff: Noa chooses today's balance between speed and courage.
chapter.reply.title: A Reply from Afar
chapter.reply.premise: A request beyond Lumen calls Noa away from a safe routine.
chapter.reply.payoff: Noa accepts the cost of recording the truth or leaving to meet it.
chapter.threshold.title: At Winter's Threshold
chapter.threshold.premise: Under festival lights, past choices gather into one direction.
chapter.threshold.payoff: Noa opens a door toward a chosen tomorrow, not a throne.
chapter.frost.title: The Seed Beneath Frost
chapter.frost.premise: After the first ledger, unfinished promises still sleep beneath Lumen's ground.
chapter.frost.payoff: Noa decides whether to call stillness failure or prepare the next bloom.
chapter.return.title: The Returning Waterway
chapter.return.premise: A distant reply returns, and Noa's choices are written on the faces of Lumen's people.
chapter.return.payoff: Noa learns to receive help and return it in the same motion.
chapter.constellation.title: Different Constellations
chapter.constellation.premise: On a night of clashing directions, even the shared map gains a blank space.
chapter.constellation.payoff: Noa chooses whether to own the answer or return its evidence to everyone.
chapter.horizon.title: The Unnamed Horizon
chapter.horizon.premise: The last horizon asks not who was right, but which rule will remain.
chapter.horizon.payoff: Noa leaves a road that the next person can verify instead of leaving only an answer.
event.firstHorizon.title: Marker of the First Horizon
event.firstHorizon.body: At the first ledger close, Noa leaves a marker for the next season.
event.firstHorizon.lumi.label: Etch the evidence constellation with Lumi
event.firstHorizon.lumi.line: The first horizon should be a direction that can be read again.
event.firstHorizon.taro.label: Raise a crossing marker with Taro
event.firstHorizon.taro.line: Let us promise where the next traveller can place a foot.
event.seedReturn.title: A Reply Turned Seed
event.seedReturn.body: The distant reply holds seeds instead of thanks. Is it a debt, or a promise?
event.seedReturn.lumi.label: Record the reply conditions with Lumi
event.seedReturn.lumi.line: Even a gift needs its conditions read to last.
event.seedReturn.bora.label: Share the seeds with Bora
event.seedReturn.bora.line: When we share what we received, debt becomes a promise we carry together.
event.emptyField.title: The Empty Field Across the River
event.emptyField.body: Only old stakes remain in the field across the river. Who will begin again?
event.emptyField.taro.label: Test a new waterway with Taro
event.emptyField.taro.line: An empty field is not a failure; it is an untested place.
event.emptyField.bora.label: Ask who will stay with Bora
event.emptyField.bora.line: Before the land, we need to hear the people who will live here.
event.witness.title: Witness to a Sprout
event.witness.body: The first seed sprouts, but everyone remembers whose hands made it happen differently.
event.witness.lumi.label: Record the order of hands with Lumi
event.witness.lumi.line: Let us record the hands that carried the work, not one person’s credit.
event.witness.bora.label: Share the first harvest with Bora
event.witness.bora.line: Even when memories differ, a shared taste can become the next promise.
event.receipt.title: The Workshop Receipt
event.receipt.body: Three missing blocks of time appear in the workshop ledger. Does unrecorded labour remain a debt?
event.receipt.lumi.label: Make the missing time public with Lumi
event.receipt.lumi.line: The empty blocks must be visible for the next calculation to be honest.
event.receipt.taro.label: Measure the work again with Taro
event.receipt.taro.line: A wrong calculation can be checked again by hand.
event.emptyCart.title: The Empty Cart
event.emptyCart.body: A cart arrives empty. Everyone names a need, but there is only one coin left.
event.emptyCart.bora.label: Find the most urgent household with Bora
event.emptyCart.bora.line: Equal portions and equal care are not always the same.
event.emptyCart.taro.label: Call the next cart with Taro
event.emptyCart.taro.line: If this was not enough, let us make the next road now.
event.sharedLabor.title: The Labour of Care
event.sharedLabor.body: At the greenhouse’s latest hour, someone’s hands tire first. Whose schedule records care?
event.sharedLabor.bora.label: Put care time on the schedule with Bora
event.sharedLabor.bora.line: If unseen work changes the day, it deserves a place in the record.
event.sharedLabor.lumi.label: Find the pattern of late hands with Lumi
event.sharedLabor.lumi.line: Repeated fatigue may reveal a rule, not a person’s weakness.
event.memoryHouse.title: The House of Memory
event.memoryHouse.body: A room opens behind the archive. Nameless boxes wait with Lumen’s past.
event.memoryHouse.lumi.label: Date each box with Lumi
event.memoryHouse.lumi.line: Memory need not be perfect, but it needs a marker to be found again.
event.memoryHouse.bora.label: Wait for the owners with Bora
event.memoryHouse.bora.line: Not deciding a name for someone is also a way to care for memory.
event.lostName.title: The Erased Name
event.lostName.body: A crossing marker has lost only its name. The reasons of the eraser and the erased differ.
event.lostName.taro.label: Ask for a new name with Taro
event.lostName.taro.line: Let us ask before writing our name over an erased place.
event.lostName.bora.label: Preserve the blank marker with Bora
event.lostName.bora.line: Let the blank remain a place someone can return to.
event.archiveLantern.title: The Archive Lantern
event.archiveLantern.body: When the lantern goes out, the same ledger reads differently. Noa must decide who carries the light.
event.archiveLantern.lumi.label: Set public reading hours with Lumi
event.archiveLantern.lumi.line: When light is not owned, judgements can be checked together.
event.archiveLantern.taro.label: Place lanterns in many places with Taro
event.archiveLantern.taro.line: Let one dark lantern not darken the whole road.
event.shadowLetter.title: Shadow from the Distant Province
event.shadowLetter.body: The second letter asks for nothing. It says Lumen’s choice has become another village’s rule.
event.shadowLetter.taro.label: Check the site with Taro
event.shadowLetter.taro.line: We must see who our rule pushed aside.
event.shadowLetter.lumi.label: Trace the rule’s path with Lumi
event.shadowLetter.lumi.line: Good intentions can become something else while travelling.
event.tideCrossing.title: Where Two Currents Meet
event.tideCrossing.body: Where the new current meets the old, neither can fill the village alone.
event.tideCrossing.bora.label: Set the sharing order with Bora
event.tideCrossing.bora.line: Where currents meet, we must decide together who drinks first.
event.tideCrossing.taro.label: Redesign the sluice with Taro
event.tideCrossing.taro.line: To change a flow, we must find the blockage by hand.
event.returningSeed.title: The Seed Comes Home
event.returningSeed.body: Part of the first seed returns to Lumen. The harvest becomes proof of a cycle, not ownership.
event.returningSeed.bora.label: Plant the returning seed with Bora
event.returningSeed.bora.line: What returns is not finished; it is someone else’s beginning.
event.returningSeed.lumi.label: Map the seed’s journey with Lumi
event.returningSeed.lumi.line: When the cycle is visible, the next promise can be checked again.
event.blankMap.title: The Incomplete Map
event.blankMap.body: All three maps share the same blank. Noa must choose how to read it without erasing it.
event.blankMap.lumi.label: Leave the blank as a measurement with Lumi
event.blankMap.lumi.line: A mark of not knowing is an exact starting point for the next judgement.
event.blankMap.taro.label: Walk the blank with Taro
event.blankMap.taro.line: A road may begin where the map ends.
event.northGate.title: The Northern Gatekeeper
event.northGate.body: At the new route’s gate, the gatekeeper asks not for a destination but a way back.
event.northGate.taro.label: Raise a return marker with Taro
event.northGate.taro.line: The courage to leave needs a promise to return and check.
event.northGate.bora.label: Open the gate for those who stay with Bora
event.northGate.bora.line: If not everyone can leave, staying must also be a road.
event.sharedCompass.title: The Compass Meeting
event.sharedCompass.body: Three compasses point to different norths. Can their standards be shared instead of choosing one?
event.sharedCompass.lumi.label: Publish the measurement standard with Lumi
event.sharedCompass.lumi.line: Before the compass, let us show everyone how to read it.
event.sharedCompass.bora.label: Listen to each different north with Bora
event.sharedCompass.bora.line: We can stand together without looking at the same place.
event.councilNight.title: The Council of Choices
event.councilNight.body: People ask Noa to decide for them. Noa opens a scene for deciding together instead.
event.councilNight.bora.label: Test the smallest agreement with Bora
event.councilNight.bora.line: Before pleasing everyone, let us find one sentence we can keep together.
event.councilNight.taro.label: Distribute the right to decide with Taro
event.councilNight.taro.line: To share responsibility, we must share the place of judgement.
event.minorityVoice.title: The Smallest Voice
event.minorityVoice.body: One person could not speak before the meeting ended. Noa must see if agreement counts silence.
event.minorityVoice.bora.label: Wait with Bora for the unheard person
event.minorityVoice.bora.line: Let time without an answer be part of the rule of care.
event.minorityVoice.lumi.label: Record when silence appeared with Lumi
event.minorityVoice.lumi.line: Without its cause, the number of an agreement cannot be trusted.
event.publicRule.title: The Day of a Shared Rule
event.publicRule.body: The new rule goes on the wall. The stronger a rule is, the shorter and more readable it should be.
event.publicRule.lumi.label: Write the verification step in one line with Lumi
event.publicRule.lumi.line: A rule outlives people only when anyone can verify it again.
event.publicRule.taro.label: Test the rule in the field with Taro
event.publicRule.taro.line: A sentence on a wall becomes real when it meets stones underfoot.
event.seedFestival.title: The Star Seed Returns
event.seedFestival.body: The first seeds finally flower in the same greenhouse. The meaning of the beginning changes.
event.seedFestival.bora.label: Name the flowers for everyone with Bora
event.seedFestival.bora.line: The best way to remember a beginning is to name the next people too.
event.seedFestival.lumi.label: Publish the sprouting conditions with Lumi
event.seedFestival.lumi.line: What looks like a miracle can happen again when its conditions are shared.
event.farewellMarket.title: The Departure Market
event.farewellMarket.body: A market opens for those leaving by the new route. Departure still needs what is left behind.
event.farewellMarket.taro.label: Set a standard for travel packs with Taro
event.farewellMarket.taro.line: Leaving lightly and leaving safely must be calculated together.
event.farewellMarket.bora.label: Find new owners for what remains with Bora
event.farewellMarket.bora.line: Let the place someone leaves remain a place another can live.
event.gardenOfNames.title: The Day Names Are Planted Again
event.gardenOfNames.body: Names returned from the memory house become small greenhouse signs. A name becomes an invitation, not ownership.
event.gardenOfNames.bora.label: Ask the owners of the names first with Bora
event.gardenOfNames.bora.line: Calling a name becomes warmer when it waits for permission.
event.gardenOfNames.lumi.label: Record the changed names with Lumi
event.gardenOfNames.lumi.line: Recording changed names keeps a person from one frozen shape.
event.nextTraveller.title: The Next Traveller’s Pack
event.nextTraveller.body: A younger traveller reads the road markers. Noa learns not to choose someone else’s answer.
event.nextTraveller.taro.label: Hide none of the road’s risks with Taro
event.nextTraveller.taro.line: A safe road is not risk-free; it is a road whose risks are shared.
event.nextTraveller.lumi.label: Give only the reading order with Lumi
event.nextTraveller.lumi.line: Instead of giving an answer, give the order for judging again.
event.handoffLedger.title: The Ledger Passed On
event.handoffLedger.body: The ledger passes to the next keeper. The first page must be read again, not only the last.
event.handoffLedger.lumi.label: Pass the wrong records too with Lumi
event.handoffLedger.lumi.line: For the next person to check again, they need where we were wrong.
event.handoffLedger.bora.label: Invite readers to the ledger with Bora
event.handoffLedger.bora.line: Let us leave readers with the ledger so it never closes alone.
event.finalHorizon.title: The Next Person’s First Step
event.finalHorizon.body: The last week’s river wind arrives. Noa leaves not an answer, but a first step that can begin again.
event.finalHorizon.taro.label: Raise a first-step marker with Taro
event.finalHorizon.taro.line: If it can be found without me, this road does not end.
event.finalHorizon.lumi.label: Leave the first question with Lumi
event.finalHorizon.lumi.line: A good record keeps the next question alive longer than the last answer.
chapter.seedReturn.title: The Seed Returns
chapter.seedReturn.premise: The first ledger’s seed travels between Lumen and the distant province, asking the difference between debt and promise.
chapter.seedReturn.payoff: Decide with whom and under what conditions to return what was received.
chapter.fairShare.title: The Time of a Fair Share
chapter.fairShare.premise: Invisible labour in the workshop and greenhouse shakes the empty spaces in the ledger.
chapter.fairShare.payoff: Calculate who is tiring, not only how fast growth happens.
chapter.memoryHouse.title: The House of Memory
chapter.memoryHouse.premise: Nameless boxes and erased markers ask who owns a record.
chapter.memoryHouse.payoff: Choose what to preserve and what to leave blank.
chapter.farShore.title: The Shadow of the Far Shore
chapter.farShore.premise: Lumen’s choice becomes another village’s rule, splitting intention from result.
chapter.farShore.payoff: Check whom the promise to help pushed aside.
chapter.blankMap.title: The Incomplete Map
chapter.blankMap.premise: Three maps hold the same blank while pointing to different norths.
chapter.blankMap.payoff: Create a shared standard without hiding what is unknown.
chapter.commons.title: The Council of Choices
chapter.commons.premise: People hand responsibility to Noa, but Lumen must learn how to decide together.
chapter.commons.payoff: Leave even unheard voices inside the rule.
chapter.returningGarden.title: The Star Seed Returns
chapter.returningGarden.premise: The first seed returns as a flower, changing the meaning of beginning and ownership.
chapter.returningGarden.payoff: Give both those leaving and those staying a place in the next season.
chapter.handoff.title: The Next Person’s First Step

milestone.spring.fail: The star seed is still asleep.
milestone.summer.fail: The bridge still shakes, but it can be crossed again.
milestone.autumn.pass: The courage to send the reply has grown.
milestone.autumn.fail: The letter waits in the drawer for the next season.
milestone.winter.pass: Noa opened the first ledger's door.
milestone.winter.fail: The door stayed closed, but left the next key.
milestone.frost.pass: A care record remained even in the stopped season.
milestone.frost.fail: The seed still waits beneath cold soil.
milestone.return.pass: A sent feeling returned as a shared promise.
milestone.return.fail: The reply still waits for the next wave.
milestone.constellation.pass: Different reasons became one public map.
milestone.constellation.fail: The map still holds blank spaces that have not faded.
milestone.horizon.pass: Noa left a horizon the next person can verify.
milestone.horizon.fail: The horizon stayed open as a question for the next run.
milestone.waterline.pass: The first waterway reached the empty field.
milestone.waterline.fail: The waterway still waits for the next pair of hands.
milestone.fair-share.pass: Invisible labour became part of the day.
milestone.fair-share.fail: A blank in the ledger still waits for someone.
milestone.memory-house.pass: Memory became a path to find again, not a closed box.
milestone.memory-house.fail: The nameless box still waits for light.
milestone.far-shore.pass: The far shore's answer changed Lumen's rule again.
milestone.far-shore.fail: The two waterways are still learning each other's pace.
milestone.blank-map.pass: The mark for unknown became a starting point to walk together.
milestone.blank-map.fail: The map still has a blank that must be crossed alone.
milestone.commons.pass: Even the smallest voice entered the rule.
milestone.commons.fail: A voice outside the agreement still knocks.
milestone.returning-garden.pass: The first seed became the next person's flower.
milestone.returning-garden.fail: The garden is still choosing a place for leaving and staying.
milestone.handoff.pass: Noa left the first step for the next person's beginning.
milestone.handoff.fail: The horizon remains open and waits for the next record.

chapter.arrival.scene.title: The First Edge of a Letter
chapter.arrival.scene.line: Do not fill an unknown name too quickly. A blank can become a road when we read it together.
chapter.crossing.scene.title: The Rhythm of a Broken Bridge
chapter.crossing.scene.line: Do not cross in one leap. Find the place where different footsteps can meet.
chapter.reply.scene.title: Hands Folding a Reply
chapter.reply.scene.line: A promise grows heavy when it grows too large. Fold it warmly to the size we can keep today.
chapter.threshold.scene.title: The Margin of the First Ledger
chapter.threshold.scene.line: Leave a margin between numbers and voices, so the next person can still ask.
chapter.frost.scene.title: Warmth in a Stopped Season
chapter.frost.scene.line: A day without growth can still be a day of care. Let us not forget how to pause.
chapter.return.scene.title: The Wind That Returned
chapter.return.scene.line: A returning road is not the beginning again. The footsteps have corrected its direction.
chapter.constellation.scene.title: Different Constellations
chapter.constellation.scene.line: When reasons differ beneath one sky, there must be more than one line between the stars.
chapter.horizon.scene.title: The Far Province Speaks
chapter.horizon.scene.line: Do not name help before listening to what the voices there actually need.
chapter.seedReturn.scene.title: The First Waterway in the Empty Field
chapter.seedReturn.scene.line: Sharing water is not losing ownership. It is making a place where it can flow again.
chapter.fairShare.scene.title: A Fair Day
chapter.fairShare.scene.line: If the fastest pace is the measure, care will always be left behind.
chapter.memoryHouse.scene.title: The Threshold of Memory
chapter.memoryHouse.scene.line: Let us not lock every memory. One marker that can be found again is enough.
chapter.farShore.scene.title: The Answer That Crossed
chapter.farShore.scene.line: A good intention can become another force far away. First, repair the words that returned.
chapter.blankMap.scene.title: A Lamp Beside the Blank Map
chapter.blankMap.scene.line: If we keep the words “we do not know,” we can promise to check together.
chapter.commons.scene.title: A Place for the Small Voice
chapter.commons.scene.line: The quieter an agreement becomes, the more we must look for someone not yet heard.
chapter.returningGarden.scene.title: A Garden for Leaving and Staying
chapter.returningGarden.scene.line: Do not choose only where flowers bloom. Leave a place where departing feet will not be hurt.
chapter.handoff.scene.title: The Next Person’s Hand
chapter.handoff.scene.line: The last page is not a cover that closes. It is a handle for the next person to open again.
